explication: OrderRestro is a self-hosted, offline-first restaurant POS and management system. The main workflow is staff using the web app to manage a menu and floor, take and settle orders, and serve those orders through kitchen and operational features; inventory, CRM, finance, reporting, and administration support that work. The README documents the product capabilities, while sampled controllers show several API-to-service calls. Many domain implementations and frontend request paths were not sampled, so those links are omitted or marked unverified rather than inferred.
